title: Prototype masked carrier evaluation handoff
summary: Human review approved the revised 2-times-3 ink-knot fusion exemplar: operands and catalyst share one compression schedule, preserve native order, hand off exclusive paint at one locus, and settle into the native result. Promotion still requires a structurally different caller.

progress.summary: Human review rejected the separate carrier; the same reversible exemplar now uses ink-knot contributor fusion. Operands and catalyst share one optical compression schedule and native spatial order. HUMAN_CHECKPOINT before promotion.
